you_should_know.title: Ex-Anoka County prosecutor charged: Expert explains trafficking allegations
you_should_know.summary: A former assistant county attorney for Anoka County, the northern suburbs of Minneapolis, is now facing serious charges for her alleged role in a commercial sex trafficking operation.

you_should_know.title: Authorities reviewing election voting vouching stunt by conservative influencer
you_should_know.description: Minnesota officials say authorities are reviewing a stunt by a conservative influencer who impersonated voters at Minneapolis polling sites while dressed in an Islamic niqab on primary day.

you_should_know.title: Families of Hopkins daycare double murder-suicide victims release statement
you_should_know.summary: The family of Kristen and Evie Brown, the victims in Wednesday's double murder-suicide in Hopkins, a suburb just west of Minneapolis, has released a statement through the Hopkins Police Department.
